name: Membership Inference Privacy Assessment (management rendition)
description: Evaluate a machine learning model's resilience to membership inference attacks before deployment to a remote edge node. Reported as a release decision.

reporting.expectedOutput: Release verdict, worst observed case against its threshold, and the compliance headline

notes: Sibling of sample_intent_mia_technical.json with the same target and parameters. The management profile reports the verdict, the worst configuration and where it occurs, and the compliance headline, but not the per-configuration matrix. Its severity floor is MEDIUM, so lower-severity findings are omitted and counted in reportProfile.findingsOmitted rather than dropped silently. Note that the worst case is reported, not the average: on the observed MIA sweep the median advantage is roughly twelve times smaller than the worst and would read as safe.
